summary: First E2E frontend test of KnowGridFlow/EOIP GUI integrated with real backend. All critical flows verified: sign-in with pre-filled bootstrap token redirects to /overview; Overview shows real stats (Vertices=226, Edges=721, Density=0.0142, 75 vertex labels, 68 edge labels, Graph by domain bars, System signals ready/disabled/not_created, Recent activity panel); theme switch works; left-nav routing works (Overview/Ask/Graph/Schema); rail toggle works; Ask page shows 'Local only' badge, Deterministic/query_plan engine badge, matched entities with evidence; Graph Explorer renders Sigma WebGL canvas with 52 nodes/51 edges, domain/fact lens toggle; Command palette opens from global-search-trigger, live search returns 8 results for 'service', clicking navigates to Entity 360; Entity 360 renders all five tabs (overview/relationships/provenance/impact/raw) and loads real data; Schema shows ontology 0.4.0 / schema 1.2 with domain badges and vertex/edge tabs + search; activity-dock visible with 'Live updates: polling'; principal menu signout returns to /signin.

issues: Minor: evidence JSON blocks shown as raw single-line pre text - readable but could benefit from pretty-print formatting
Shows 'Partial result — not all data was returned.' banner even when subgraph loads successfully - may confuse users; consider only showing when truncation genuinely happened

action_items: (Optional) Consider suppressing 2 initial 401 console errors on /signin: auth.tsx tries /security/tokens/verify before fallback - works but noisy. Could switch to bootstrap-first or silence the fallback 401.
(Optional UX) Review 'Partial result' banner trigger logic on Graph Explorer so it only appears when results are actually truncated.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow logs 401 errors to console on every sign-in due to verify-then-fallback pattern - functionally correct but creates noisy console; consider catching 401 silently or trying bootstrap first.
GraphExplorer: 'Partial result' warning appears even on normal subgraph loads - verify truncation detection logic.
test_credentials: Bearer token: eoip-local-dev-token-0123456789abcdef, tenant: default (pre-filled in sign-in)
seed_data_creation: None - backend seeds ~226 vertices/721 edges automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path flows (sign-in, overview, ask, graph, entity 360 all 5 tabs, schema, command palette, theme, nav, rail toggle, signout, activity dock) verified working against real backend. Only minor UX polish suggestions remain. On next iteration focus on: (a) edge cases like empty query, invalid entity ID, empty token sign-in, (b) Entity 360 impact tab blast-radius content validation, (c) command palette keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K), (d) high-contrast themes.
